reviews.comment: Probably one of the easier classes I'll have to take. Really enjoyed his class and found it easy as long as you do everything on time. Study for the tests/do good on them and you'll make an A. Papers and HW are usually a 100. Have to get a NEW textbook for the HW. Gives practice quizzes that reflect some test questions, but also memorize your notes
By far my favorite professor I've had. He truly cares about his students, and wants everyone to succeed. I can't wait for the opportunity to take one of his classes again.

Awesome prof. I had him for an accelerated class, which was very homework heavy, but he was very lenient with deadlines because he knew he was throwing a lot of work at us. Nice guy, easy to talk to, jokes a lot, and cares about students learning the material. Buy a new textbook for this class, don't procrastinate.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's one of the more 'chill' professors I've had, but still holds standards for his students. This class can take some serious time to review papers, so be prepared for lots of trips to the writing center. He wants students to succeed though, and will provide the needs necessary for you to make an A.

Knowledgeable about the construction industry and project management. Has an accent and low voice so try to sit in the front. Quizzes every Friday usually after going over powerpoint of the chapter. Need to read and review powerpoint to pass quizzes and exams. 12 Quizzes 6 assignment/groups 3 exams and weekly Q&A google doc spreadsheet.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS
